name: Abdugafforov Shokhrukh
about:
I’m a passionate and self-driven front-end developer with a deep interest in beautiful UIs, smooth interactions, and clean code. My journey into web development began with a desire to create things people can actually use — now it’s my daily obsession.

I believe design isn’t just how it looks, but also how it feels and functions. I love crafting responsive, user-friendly websites that blend aesthetics with performance. Whether it’s writing semantic HTML, styling with modern CSS, or building logic with JavaScript — I enjoy every part of the process.

Currently, I’m focused on sharpening my React skills, learning backend fundamentals, and building projects that push me to grow. In the future, I see myself as a full-stack developer working with teams that care about accessibility, performance, and elegant design.

Outside of coding, you’ll find me sketching ideas on paper, getting inspired by great UI, or reading about tech, business, and minimalism.
Curion-text: Curion is a modern and minimalistic web app that allows users to explore global currencies, view exchange rates, and compare values in real-time.
skill1: Creating semantic layout and responsive page structure.
skill2: Cross-browser styling using Flexbox and Grid layouts.
skill3: Building interactivity with events and DOM manipulation.
skill4: Version control, pull requests, and collaboration using Git.
skill5: Rapid UI development with a responsive component library.
skill6: Designing UI mockups, prototypes, and design systems.
